frozen_original.synopsis: In July 2008, Russian fertilizer billionaire Dmitry Rybolovlev purchased Donald Trump's Palm Beach, Florida mansion for $95 million — approximately $40 million above comparable market value at the time, in the middle of a real estate market collapse. Trump had bought the estate for $41.4 million in 2004 and sold it to Rybolovlev without ever having lived in it or significantly improving it, netting a windfall profit. Investigators and reporters later scrutinized the transaction as a potential vehicle for transferring funds to Trump, noting that Rybolovlev had no apparent use for the property and that the inflated price was difficult to explain on market terms. The mansion was later demolished and subdivided. Rybolovlev's name surfaced again in 2016 when his private jet was repeatedly spotted near Trump's campaign planes on the same dates and in the same cities.
